scope: Exact-encoding Long64 MOV CR8 read/write backed by the standalone xAPIC TPR, with self-IPI priority gating
source: Intel 64 and IA-32 SDM release 093, Volume 3A §§13.8.6–13.8.6.1 and Volume 2B MOV to/from control registers
review: independent gpt-6.1-sol/high review passed; P2 canonical48 fetch boundary and P3 ISR bank assertion findings fixed and confirmed closed

checks.layout_check: reports only the pre-existing unmapped root smoke/ (ISSUE-056)

limitations: only exact MOV RAX,CR8 and MOV CR8,RAX encodings in the opt-in Long64 profile are admitted
APIC operations must be serialized by the caller across the complete helper call, including fetch and effect application; no architectural serialization guarantee is claimed
general CR8 decoding, CPU interrupt acceptance and handler delivery, IDT/IF, HLT wakeup, paged-session/JIT integration, and default board wiring are not implemented
parent S4-25 and Stage 4 remain open
